data.name: Khizer
data.gender_notes: Khizer is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic 'Khazana' meaning treasure or 'Sawzan' meaning gardener, Khizer is a name that denotes both the power and intelligence of a wise steward over the riches of nature and life. The name Khizer carries the meaning “Gardener, or owner of treasure” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Khizer usually hope their child will grow to embody gardener, or owner of treasure and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the nurturing of one's inner garden, or the cultivation of wisdom and knowledge as a source of personal treasure.
data.etymology: Khizer belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gardener, or owner of treasure.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Khizer total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
